partagas-dr--partagas-classic.description: The original General Cigar Partagás, made in the Dominican Republic, is defined by its toothy Cameroon wrapper over a Mexican San Andrés binder and Dominican and Mexican long filler. Medium and classic, it pairs the wrapper's sweetness with cedar, light earth and nuts, baking spice and a hint of cocoa.

partagas-dr--black-label.description: Partagás Black Label, made in the Dominican Republic, is built around a dark, oily Connecticut medio tiempo wrapper, with a sun-grown La Vega Especial binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan ligero. Full in body and strength, it brings espresso, earth and leather with licorice, pepper and baking spice.

thirds.notes: Earthy, spicy and leathery, with a heavy grain note and a savoury depth.
Roasted coffee and smoky wood, dried dark fruit, black and red pepper and dark chocolate, yet well balanced.
Cool-burning and aromatic to the end, rich enough to feel filling.

sources.title: Kaplowitz – Partagás Black Label in review

partagas-dr--legend.description: Released in 2018, Partagás Legend is made in the Dominican Republic from deeply aged Dominican filler, a Honduran Olancho San Agustín binder and a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper. Smooth and medium-bodied, it leans on sweet natural tobacco with cashew, cedar, light cocoa and white pepper.

partagas-dr--cortado.description: Cortado is the first shade-wrapped Partagás, made in Nicaragua with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper, an Indonesian binder and filler from Jamastran, San Andrés, Condega and Jalapa. Mild to medium, it shows cedar and dark wood with a touch of fig and a floral finish.

partagas-dr--valle-verde.description: Released in 2023 and rolled at HATSA in Honduras, Valle Verde wraps Mexican and Nicaraguan filler from the 2020 harvest and a 2015 Cameroon binder in an oily San Andrés leaf from Veracruz. Medium to full, it opens with pepper and earth, then softens into cocoa, leather, brown sugar and cream.

thirds.notes: Generous pepper and earth with a subtle sweetness and herbal spice; mint and clove for one taster.
The spice eases; creamy sweetness and chocolate come forward, leather grows and a black-tea note appears.
Spice and earth rise again, while a creamy note carries some samples to the end.

partagas-dr--1845-extra-oscuro.description: Introduced in 2014 and made in the Dominican Republic, 1845 Extra Oscuro wraps a dark Connecticut Habano leaf around a La Vega Especial binder and filler that includes rum-barrel-aged Dominican tobacco with Honduran and Nicaraguan ligero. Full-bodied, it shows earth, wood, cocoa and cream with pepper and a dark-cherry note.

thirds.notes: Sweetness first, then red pepper and an early black-cherry note over earth and wood.
Earth and wood, cream and cocoa with spice and leather, as the strength rises to medium-full.
Cream leads over wood and cocoa, a fruity hint appears and the spice fades.
